description: Region flash analyzer (README: Region flash analyzer). Each case's derivation states how its transitions were worked out by hand; tools/limiter-region-vectors.py checks them against a model of the README and writes this file.

cases.name: full-screen-0.15-10hz-measure
cases.derivation: Every region alternates 0 and 0.15 every 50 ms at 60 Hz: each alternation is a change >= 0.1 with darker image 0, so all 36 regions complete a change at every 50k (k = 1..39). The window holds min(k, 20): exceeds from 350 (seven transitions), peak 10 flashes.

cases.name: full-screen-0.15-10hz-admit
cases.derivation: The same frames admitted. 50..300 fill the window; later 0.15 frames would rise from the held 0 image and are refused, 0 frames are admitted. 1050..1300 are admitted as 50..300 leave; from 1350 the window is full again. At most three flashes are ever displayed.

cases.name: localized-block-10hz-measure
cases.derivation: Regions 14, 15, 20, 21 (a 2 by 2 block, 11.1% of the screen) alternate 0 and 0.5 every 50 ms. The 2 by 2 window at the block holds four completing regions, more than one, so every 50k (k = 1..22) is a transition: exceeds from 350, peak 10 flashes. A screen-area rule (more than 25% of the screen) would miss it.

cases.name: localized-block-10hz-admit
cases.derivation: The same block admitted: 50..300, then 1050 and 1100 as 50 and 100 leave.

cases.name: single-region-not-a-flash
cases.derivation: Region 14 alternates 0 and 1 every 50 ms. One region is 25% of a 2 by 2 window, not more, so no transition.

cases.name: distant-regions-not-concurrent
cases.derivation: Regions 0 and 35 (opposite corners) flash together; no 2 by 2 window holds both.

cases.name: regions-straddling-window-tiles
cases.derivation: Regions 1 and 2 (row 0, columns 1 and 2) flash together; the sliding window at column 1 holds both, so 50, 100 and 150 are transitions.

cases.name: diagonal-regions-in-one-window
cases.derivation: Regions 0 and 7 ((0, 0) and (1, 1)); the window at (0, 0) holds both.

cases.name: darker-image-boundary
cases.derivation: 1 by 1 grid. 0.8 <-> 1 has darker image 0.8, not below 0.8: no transition. 0.75 counts at 400, 500, 600, 700. The fall from 1 to 0.85 at 800 completes only when it reaches 0.78125 at 900.

cases.name: change-boundary-and-small-dips
cases.derivation: 1 by 1 grid. 0.09375 is below the 0.1 change; 0.1 above the low of 0 completes a rise at 300. Dips of 0.0375 and 0.053125 below the extreme are ignored, the rise extends to 0.3125, and the fall to 0.1875 (0.125) completes at 1000.

cases.name: default-grid-six-vs-seven-regions
cases.derivation: Default 16 by 16 grid and field: the window is floor(16 / 3 + 0.5) = 5 regions a side, 25 regions, and the area limit is 0.25 * 25 = 6.25 regions. Six regions (rows 0-1, columns 0-2) rise to 0.5 at 50 and fall at 100: 6 is not more than 6.25, no transition. Seven (adding row 0, column 3; all inside the 5 by 5 window at (0, 0)) rise at 150 and fall at 200: 7 > 6.25, transitions at 150 and 200.

cases.name: red-8hz-measure
cases.derivation: 2 by 1 grid, window 1 region. Region 0 alternates red 0 and 0.25 (luminance 0 and that of (0.25, 0, 0)) every 125 ms: 0.25 > 0.0625 completes at every 125k (k = 1..12), luminance 0.05315 < 0.1 never does; region 1's 0.0625 is not more than 0.0625. The red window holds min(k, 8): exceeds from 875, peak 4.

cases.name: red-8hz-admit-one-red-flash
cases.derivation: The same frames admitted with maxRedFlashes 1: 125 and 250 admitted; red frames refused until 125 leaves; 1125 and 1250 admitted, 1375 refused.

cases.name: uncredited-gap-and-reset
cases.derivation: 1 by 1 grid. Transitions at 100..400; the 1600 ms gap to 2000 credits nothing, so they keep their ages (1700..2000) and 2000 is the fifth; 2100 and 2200 make seven, which exceeds. After reset, 0 at 50 is the eighth (earlier ones at -450..50).

cases.name: gap-250-credited
cases.derivation: 1 by 1 grid. A transition at 50, then steady frames 250 ms apart (300, 550, 800, 1050). A gap of exactly 250 ms is not above 250, so it is credited: at 1050 the transition is 1000 ms old and has left the window.

cases.name: gap-250.25-uncredited
cases.derivation: 1 by 1 grid. A transition at 50, then a 250.25 ms gap to 300.25: above 250, so it credits nothing and the transition keeps its age 0 (now at 300.25). The later 250 ms gaps are credited: at 1050.25 it is 750 ms old and still counts; at 1300.25 it is 1000 ms old and has left.

cases.name: red-rule-scale-wcag20
cases.derivation: Separates the rules. (0.5, 0, 0) and (0.25, 0, 0) alternate every 125 ms (luminance 0.1063 and 0.05315, change 0.05315 < 0.1). WCAG 2.0: red levels 0.5 and 0.25 differ by 0.25 > 0.0625, so every 125k (k = 1..12) is a red transition; exceeds from 875, peak 4.

cases.name: red-rule-scale-iso
cases.derivation: The same frames under ISO 9241-391: both are red primaries at u'v' (0.45070, 0.52289), distance 0 (the power-of-two scale is exact), never more than 0.2: no red transition.

cases.name: red-rule-hue-wcag20
cases.derivation: Separates the rules the other way. (0.0625, 0, 0) and (0, 0, 0.0625) alternate every 125 ms. WCAG 2.0: red levels 0.0625 and 0, a change not more than 0.0625: no red transition.

cases.name: red-rule-hue-iso
cases.derivation: The same frames under ISO 9241-391: saturated red (0.45070, 0.52289) against blue (0.17544, 0.15789), 0.45715 apart: every 125k (k = 1..12) is a red transition; exceeds from 875, peak 4.

cases.name: red-rule-wander-wcag20
cases.derivation: Grey, blue, pink, grey, blue, pink at 0, 125, .., 625. WCAG 2.0 red levels 0, 0, 0.1875, 0, 0, 0.1875: rise at 250, fall at 375, rise at 625.

cases.name: red-rule-wander-iso
cases.derivation: The same frames under ISO 9241-391. 250: pink (saturated) is 0.38020 from blue, shown since the baseline: a transition. 375: grey is 0.14782 from pink, not more than 0.2: none (WCAG 2.0 counts it). 500: blue is 0.38020 from pink: a transition. 625: pink against blue again: a transition.

cases.name: red-rule-black-iso-admit
cases.derivation: Black and (0.25, 0, 0) alternate every 125 ms under ISO 9241-391 with maxRedFlashes 1. Black has no chromaticity; the README counts black against a saturated red. 125 and 250 are admitted; red frames are refused (the held black image does not change) until 125 leaves; 1125 and 1250 admitted, 1375 refused.

cases.name: red-rule-threshold-under-iso
cases.derivation: Just under the threshold. (0.25, 0, 0) and (0.25, c, c) with c = 403/4096 alternate every 125 ms under ISO 9241-391. The red primary (0.45070, 0.52289) is saturated; the mixture (0.255220, 0.480715) is 0.199982 from it, not more than 0.2: no red transition. Luminance 0.05315 and 0.13062, change 0.07747 < 0.1.

cases.name: red-rule-threshold-over-iso
cases.derivation: Just over the threshold. The same with c = 404/4096: the mixture (0.255039, 0.480676) is 0.200167 from the red primary, more than 0.2: every 125k (k = 1..12) is a red transition; exceeds from 875, peak 4. Luminance change 0.07766 < 0.1.

cases.name: red-rule-drift-iso
cases.derivation: Slow drift. (0.25, j/128, j/128) at 125j for j = 0..13 under ISO 9241-391, moving along the line from the red primary to the white point in steps of at most 0.03746. j = 0..4 are saturated and held; every later state has smaller u' and v' than the red primary, so the saturated box's farthest corner is the red primary and each later state is compared with its true distance from red: 0.12752 at j = 5 rising to 0.19635 at j = 12, none more than 0.2, then 0.20235 at j = 13: one red transition, at 1625. Luminance rises from 0.05315 to 0.13312, by 0.07997 < 0.1.

cases.name: red-rule-box-corner-iso
cases.derivation: The conservative bounding-box behaviour, not strict Note 3. (0.5, 0, 0.25), (0.5, 0.125, 0.125), (0.5, 0, 0) at 0, 125, 250 under ISO 9241-391. The first two are not saturated (R / (R + G + B) = 2/3) and count nothing. The third, the red primary (0.45070, 0.52289), is 0.16447 from (0.35167, 0.39157) and 0.16461 from (0.28979, 0.48817): no held state is more than 0.2 away, so Note 3 alone would not count it. The held box's farthest corner (0.28979, 0.39157) is du 0.16091, dv 0.13132, 0.20769 away, so the analyzer counts a red transition at 250 (an over-refusal it documents). Luminance 0.12435, 0.20473, 0.1063: the rise 0.08038 and fall 0.09843 are below 0.1.
